Description Description This India satellite image provides a landscape view of the subcontinent, with the country’s distinctive peninsula forming the basis of the composition. It gives projects about India a geographic context beyond a simple outline. Use it in regional presentations, editorial graphics and printed displays. The image works as a visual backdrop for themes connecting India’s coast, interior and northern mountain setting. FAQ Can I use this map in GIS programs? This map is not geo-referenced, but feel free to contact us to obtain a file with geo data if needed. Can I get this map in a different projection? Yes, we offer custom projections upon request. Contact us for details. Can I get the map in a different format? Yes, if you need the map in a different file format, please contact us. We offer various formats to meet your needs. Is it possible to make a 3D model based on this satellite map? Yes, of course. Please specify the desired 3D model format, dimensions and how you will use it. This will help me to prepare an optimal model for you. Is it possible to get a higher resolution version of the map? Absolutely! If you require a higher resolution version, just let us know, and we can provide a version that fits your requirements. Can you provide the map with different projections or without boundaries? Yes, we can customize the map with different projections or remove boundaries as needed. Please reach out to us with your specifications, and we’ll accommodate your request. I need a custom size or additional features. What should I do? For custom sizes or additional features, please contact us directly. We are happy to work with you to create a tailored map that fits your specific needs. Can I print this map in large format? Absolutely! The map is available in high resolution, making it suitable for large format printing without losing detail. Be sure to check with your printing company if they require RGB-to-CMYK color conversion for best results. What other uses does this map have? In addition to educational and decorative uses, the map can be utilized for trip planning , natural resource research , and as a creative gift . If you have any other questions or special requests, feel free to get in touch with us. We’re here to help! Description Description AuthaGraph World Map The AuthaGraph world map offers a flat global composition for designs that explore different arrangements of continents and oceans. It provides a visual alternative for world-map layouts where the choice of centre is part of the design. Use it in global editorial graphics, geographic presentations and print compositions. The examples on this page illustrate several arrangements, including views centred on Antarctica, the North Pole and Africa. Global layout and projection The AuthaGraph map provides the projection context for this world-map composition. The source view and the alternative arrangements shown below illustrate the product’s approach to presenting global geography. Mosaic compositions The mosaic workflow is intended for custom global layouts with different centres. The illustrated arrangements show how a shared world image can be composed around different regions. This makes the map useful for editorial world views, geographic displays and poster design in which global arrangement is a central visual decision.
